specification.section: printed p.8 / PDF page 9, 3.2.4 CRS; printed p.7 / PDF page 8, 3.2.3 local coordinates
specification.statement_absent_crs: CRS が存在しない場合、データは WGS84 緯度経度座標で提供されます。
specification.statement_null_crs: CRS が null の場合、座標は推定できません。
specification.statement_local: ローカル座標は、会場に対してローカルに定義された座標のセットです。座標系は、北向きではなく自然な向きで定義されます。

geojson-level-geom.frame: WGS84 longitude/latitude (standard GeoJSON; the spec's absent-CRS sentence applies)

path-level-geom.frame: UNKNOWN local frame; drawing-local is an unverified hypothesis; a null CRS means the coordinates cannot be inferred
path-level-geom.verification: UNVERIFIED: this pass did not check that these coordinates share the frame ref_frame.transform consumes

com-map.frame: drawing metadata only; drawings[0].ref_frame.transform defines drawing-local to longitude/latitude

v5_nav.frame: venue-local mx/my, not drawing-local; not a standard GeoJSON geometry member, so the absent-CRS sentence does not classify it; affine 1 takes it to drawing-local, affine 2 to longitude/latitude; the projection behind mx/my is UNKNOWN except for the two affines

geographic_envelope.matches: docs/gis/HANDOFF.md:70 and gap SJ-06 rounded envelope

transform.order: nav affine, then drawing affine, then horizontal ENU; no fitted correction
transform.coefficient_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON array in source order
transform.tuple_order: [a,b,c,d,e,f]; u=a*x+c*y+e, v=b*x+d*y+f; the drawing result is (u,v) = (longitude,latitude)
transform.applies_to: v5_nav.json only; Path GeoJSON members have a separate UNKNOWN local frame (drawing-local is an unverified hypothesis) and must not go through this pair

station_frame.frame_artifact_source_crs: EPSG:6697 (the station frame artifact's own source CRS for PLATEAU context geometry; NOT a CRS for S03 data, whose datum stays UNKNOWN)
station_frame.horizontal: geodetic -> ECEF -> ENU at the origin, evaluated at height 0 for the horizontal result only; x east, y north; no additional curvature correction beyond that exact projection
station_frame.axis_order: source latitude,longitude; station x east, y north, z up; renderer x east, y up, z -north
station_frame.heights: none in S03; z stays null; no floor elevation asserted

datum.assumed_for_projection: WGS84 lon/lat used as JGD2011 geographic; no realization/epoch correction

frame.purpose: CRS evidence for the S03 archive and the handoff frame for the WP7 path transform; not a routing frame and not a survey control

composite.linear_part: diagonal in float64: longitude depends only on mx, latitude only on my with a sign inversion
composite.rule: GRS80 radii of curvature at the stated latitude; derived only, never applied to a transform

node_transform.rule: both affines in the stated order, then counted against the level-geometry envelope

check_a.threshold: 95% overall and on each assessed level
check_a.reason: level 64677 is below the per-level threshold; the overall FAIL follows from it

64678.note: passes its own threshold; its 13 outside nodes are residual outliers, not a level failure

decided_2026_10_24: Datum UNKNOWN and not asserted; the absent-CRS statement is used for projection only (docs/gis/s03/positions-import-contract.md:7).
Transform method: nav affine, drawing affine, horizontal ENU, no fitted correction; reproduces the join study.
Only 25 approximate gate and transfer points and 19 platform names may be derived and labelled; no other S03 geometry ships (docs/gis/decisions/2026-10-24-s03-positions-ruling.md:10).
Three source features are excluded whole, never repaired or moved.
This note is not a rights PASS: the derived outputs stay CONDITIONAL with licence fields UNKNOWN, and the source gate stays HOLD.
open: WGS84 realization/epoch and any WGS84 to JGD2011 horizontal offset are UNKNOWN; none is applied.
Absolute accuracy and station alignment are not established; the only control is the E27 overlap sample.
Why level 64677 fails containment, and why 64678 has 13 outside nodes while passing, is unresolved; only 64677 fails and the overall FAIL follows from it.
The source projection behind mx/my and its linear unit are UNKNOWN; the 0.44% anisotropy is derived only.
Publication of nav paths, path geometry or opening hours is not covered by any ruling; paths stay HOLD.
Physical heights are absent from S03.
